og_sending_lead: No reliance on SendGrid or Mailgun. A custom `sending-engine/sendWorker.js` with rate limiting, timezone-aware scheduling and a complete tracking system.

og_sending_features.title: Rate limiting
og_sending_features.desc: 30s default delay between sends, configurable per campaign and provider.

og_sending_features.title: Smart Sending
og_sending_features.desc: Per-contact timezone — optimal send time for max open-rate.

og_sending_features.desc: 1×1 pixel via `/track/open/:id.png`. Logs IP, user-agent and timestamp.

og_sending_features.desc: Redirect through `/track/click/:trackingId/:encodedUrl` with safe URL encoding.

og_sending_features.desc: Gmail OAuth integration — auto-detects replies and maps them to campaigns.

og_sending_features.desc: Auto-cleanup of bounced/spam addresses, AWS SES feedback loop.

og_sending_features.title: Multi-provider
og_sending_features.desc: Gmail OAuth, AWS SES or Nodemailer SMTP — each workspace picks its provider.

og_sending_how_text: API receives a campaign → writes it to `campaign_queue` → background worker (`worker.js` + `sending-engine/sendWorker.js`) picks up batches, runs them through Juice for CSS inlining, injects tracking pixels and links, and sends via the chosen provider with rate limiting. Tracking events (open/click/reply/bounce) flow through dedicated routes and refresh the engagement scoring materialized view.

og_subs_how_text: The `contact_engagement_scores` materialized view aggregates events from `email_events` and recomputes the score every few minutes (cron). Scores map to 3 buckets: hot (>70), warm (30–70), cold (<30). When a user filters "hot only", the query runs against the view directly, with no full table scans.

og_teams_features.title: Row-Level Security
og_teams_features.desc: 39 policies on 9 tables. Every row knows its organization — nobody sees other people's data, even by accident.

og_teams_features.title: JWT auth + backend proxy
og_teams_features.desc: All `/api/*` routes require JWT. AI calls go through a proxy — the OpenAI key never touches the frontend.

og_teams_features.title: GDPR-ready
og_teams_features.desc: Consent tracking, List-Unsubscribe header, HTML sanitization (DOMPurify + sanitize-html), CORS rules.

og_teams_features.title: Dual billing
og_teams_features.desc: Stripe subscriptions for plans + AI Credits for pay-as-you-go AI calls.

og_teams_features.title: DNS Setup Wizard
og_teams_features.desc: Walks the user through SPF, DKIM and DMARC setup for custom domains.

og_teams_how_text: RLS in Supabase isn't a "plus" — it's the primary isolation mechanism. Every resource has `organization_id` and a policy that checks `auth.uid()` against membership. Even if someone bypasses the API, the database refuses access to other tenants' data. The `complete_onboarding()` SECURITY DEFINER RPC handles critical operations with controlled privileges.

mg_hub_faq.q: Why Magento 2 and not Shopify or WooCommerce?
mg_hub_faq.a: Magento gives you data ownership and full control over the catalog, pricing, and custom logic — without monthly platform fees like Shopify Plus. Once a shop crosses 5–10k SKUs, multistore, and complex B2B/B2C scenarios, Magento pays off. For smaller shops run by a marketing team, Shopify or WooCommerce is often the better choice.

mg_hub_faq.q: Hyvä or Luma — what do you recommend?
mg_hub_faq.a: Hyvä by default for new shops and most redesigns. Hyvä is 3–5× faster than Luma, builds quicker, and development hurts less. We optimize Luma only when there's a real reason (e.g. lots of existing custom modules without a Hyvä compat layer).

mg_hub_faq.q: How long does an M1 → M2 migration take?
mg_hub_faq.a: Realistic range: 8–20 weeks, depending on the number of extensions, custom logic, and data migration scope. Before we quote we do an audit (1–2 weeks) and only then commit to a timeline.

mg_hub_faq.q: How much does development or migration cost?
mg_hub_faq.a: After the audit we offer fixed price or T&M with a ceiling. For migrations we usually go fixed price, since scope is known; for new development T&M with sprint pricing tends to work better.

mg_hub_faq.q: What kind of post-launch support do you offer?
mg_hub_faq.a: Three SLA tiers: Bronze (best-effort, quarterly health check), Silver (monthly health check + security patches in 72h), Gold (24/7 on-call + monthly release window). Details after the first call.

mg_hub_faq.q: Do you handle GDPR and PCI compliance?
mg_hub_faq.a: Yes. GDPR: data retention policies, anonymization scripts, cookie consent integrations. PCI: we never store card numbers — we use Stripe/Adyen/AllSecure tokenization, plus we configure TLS, headers, and logging per PCI DSS 4.0.
